summary: Verified HelpChat CSS positioning fix (mb-[76px]). On desktop (1920x1080), the chat input and send button are fully visible above the 'Made with Emergent' badge with a clear vertical gap; opening, typing, and closing the chat all work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: HelpChat.jsx uses mb-[76px] to lift panel above the Emergent badge. Fix works correctly on desktop viewport. Recommended: consider also applying similar spacing on very small mobile viewports if the header hamburger exposes the Help button — currently on <sm viewport the Help button appears hidden behind the mobile menu, so the fix is not visually testable on 390px until menu is opened.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified: HelpChat panel input (data-testid='help-chat-input') sits above the platform's 'Made with Emergent' badge (#emergent-badge). On desktop 1920x1080: input bounding box bottom=991px; badge top=1024px (~33px gap). Input accepts typing, send button is enabled (33x41), close button dismisses the portal. All 4 requested testids exist and function.
rca of the issue: Not a new bug — verification of an applied CSS fix. The panel now uses mb-[76px] (both mobile and sm+ breakpoints) plus h-[70vh] on mobile and sm:max-h-[calc(100vh-7rem)] on desktop, reserving ~76px at the bottom of the viewport so the Emergent badge never overlaps the input row.
